_comment: Ground truth for the ONIONLAB target services. Used only to grade a live
run. The crawler never reads it, the engines never see it, and neither
service serves it. Against a genuine third-party service no equivalent
exists, and the correct output there is a set of hypotheses with no
Kept in sync with MARKET_ACCOUNTS and FORUM_ACCOUNTS in site/market.py;
tests/test_live.py fails if the two drift apart.

structure.OP-A: four accounts across BOTH services: three on the market (one with a deliberately unrelated handle and a rotated key) and one on the forum
structure.OP-C: two accounts, one per service, unrelated handles
structure.OP-D, OP-F..OP-J: singletons, present so false positives have somewhere to land

_comment: Clear-web identifiers deliberately published by an account, in the
phrasing a careless operator actually uses. `value` is what the harvest
should find; `should_rank` is the band the context scorer should place
it in; `pivot` is what the correlation stage should be able to say.

kavach.supply@gmail.example.pivot: local part normalises to the same string as the handle kavach_supply

hl.trading@gmail.example.pivot: leaked on the forum; attaches to the operator's market accounts through the resolved cluster

ninelives.dev@gmail.example.pivot: local part normalises onto the market handle ninelives

sundowner.mail@yandex.example.pivot: singleton operator; identity correlation only, no cluster to widen to

stillwater.trading@example.com.pivot: local part contains the handle stem

harborlight.ops@protonmail.example.pivot: anonymous provider, so ranked below the mainstream leaks even though the correlation is just as strong

paperghost-shop.example.org.pivot: clear-web shop domain; pivots to certificate transparency and registration history

_comment: Boilerplate present on every page. A naive scraper collects these as
eagerly as it collects a vendor's private mailbox. The context scorer
must place all of them below the real leaks; that separation is the
step Wangchuk & Rathod performed by hand.
decoys.security@example.org: phishing report address on the mirrors page
decoys.noreply@example.com: support enquiries line on the index
